goal: Edit the allowed local files to block invalid Done in the authoritative reducer state BEFORE candidate adoption. Do not merely describe a fix.
instructions: Read the reference reducer and the relevant fall12/fixture12 before editing. Only these exact files may change.

For invalid Done: advance received transport cursor according to existing K2 delivery rule, but retain the previous task state and return a rejection diagnostic. Do not add/create task state if no accepted previous task exists.
Keep ABWEICHUNG_AKTIV=False: free strings are not proof. Do not add auth infrastructure.
Read accepted proof data from initial_state as well as earlier accepted events, so snapshot+tail and full reduction agree.
Do not alter K1 candidate/chain checks, K2 buffer/replay, R4/R5, B1/B5 or scope/basis rules.
Invert the incorrect R45 expectation which currently REQUIRES Done despite missing proof. Require unchanged task status AND a diagnostic.

Update the smallest fixtures/negative checks needed. Include valid exact proof=>Done and no/fremd/wrong-criteria/later-fail/free-strings=>no Done. If previously invalid data is used as happy input elsewhere, do not weaken acceptance criteria; explain the precise blocker rather than broadening scope.
You cannot run commands: Bash/network/other agents are disabled. Return CA_IMPLEMENTED with changed files, exact behavior, and tests NOT_RUN_BY_FORGE. Independent Sentinel will execute the checks.
Only a patch is returned by the host wrapper. Do not publish to GitHub, create branches, merge or deploy. Stop after this one bounded task.
